title: Willows（1985.365）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1985.365）
medium: album leaf; ink and light color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1100s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: album leaf; ink and light color on silk
The Kelvin Smith Collection, given by Mrs. Kelvin Smith

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Mentioned and Reproduced: cat. no. 43, p. 58）

Cunningham, Michael R. “Painting the Poetry of the Natural World.” The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 75, no. 7 (September 1988): 279–291.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 285, fig. 7; Reproduced: pl. IX）

Griswold, William, Xiaofei Tian, Richard Von Glahn, Feng Zhao, S. J. Vainker, Masaaki Itakura, Jiang Wu, et al. China’s Southern Paradise: Treasures from the Lower Yangzi Delta. Edited by Clarissa Von Spee. Cleveland, OH: The Cleveland Museum of Art, 2023.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 173, no. 56）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

provenance.text: (N. V. Hammer, New York, NY, sold to Mr. and Mrs. Kelvin Smith)
The Kelvin Smith Collection, Cleveland, OH, given by Mrs. Kelvin [Eleanor Armstrong] Smith [1899–1998] to the Cleveland Museum of Art
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。

reception.text: 展览史照录自馆方档案，**本库未核对展览图录原件**；仅现行档案（current）部分，馆方标为 legacy 的旧记录未收。
